S50Z26.today_summary: 966.8 on the Z26 future, -6.1 pts, a fifth straight lower session that leaves spot 6.8 pts above the 960 put wall and 53.2 pts below max pain at 1020. Net dealer gamma deepened to -19.3k baht/pt and is negative at every strike, so hedging flow amplifies rather than dampens any break of 960. Today's flow split hard: P/C volume 1.48 against P/C OI 0.82, with 1,253 fresh puts struck at 930 and -423 closed at 960 - protection is being bought, but 30 pts lower. Call OI keeps building into the rally path (+189 at 1010, 490 volume), capping upside at the same 1010 strike where gamma turns call-dominated.
what_changed: 930-strike puts appeared from nothing: 0 to 1,253 OI on 1,301 volume in one session, the single largest flow on the board.
960 put wall lost -423 OI today (-480 over 5 sessions) despite 698 volume - longs monetising the wall as spot reaches it.
Net GEX deepened from -18.2k to -19.3k baht/pt (-10.6k five sessions ago), extending the short-gamma condition for a sixth session.
P/C volume ratio jumped 1.10 to 1.48 while P/C OI stayed 0.82 - today's flow is put-led against call-heavy standing positioning.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: Across 2026-11-20 to 2026-11-27 the anchor fell 35.7 pts (1002.5 to 966.8, -3.6%) with no bounce session, while max pain sat frozen at 1020 - the spot-to-max-pain gap widened from 17.5 to 53.2 pts, which is max-pain failure rather than a stretched spring. Net GEX went from -10.6k to -19.3k baht/pt (1.8x deeper) and the per-strike gamma boundary migrated down 1030 to 1010, so each leg lower has put dealers further into amplifying hedges. Total OI rose +3,922 to 43,610 (+9.9%), which rules out Unwind: risk is being added into the decline, not abandoned. ATM IV expanded +1.70 to 15.04, a 7-session high, so there is no compressed-vol case for selling premium here. The near call wall chased price down 1050 to 1030 to 1010 while the 960 put wall held its strike but lost -480 OI - the corridor is narrowing from above and eroding from below, with the fresh 930 build naming the next burden level.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 960 / 930
strategies.rationale: The matrix structure for short gamma + Squeeze below a put wall + elevated IV: 8.10 pts of debit buys the break of a 960 wall that shed -423 OI today, with the short leg parked at 930 where 1,253 fresh puts were just printed.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss 8.10 pts = net debit (960 put 14.50 ask - 930 put 6.40 bid); max gain 21.90 pts on the 30-pt width; breakeven 951.90.
strategies.invalidation: A daily close above 1010 - the per-strike gamma boundary and near call wall - restores call-dominated gamma and voids the amplification thesis.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 970 / 940
strategies.rationale: Higher-delta expression (-0.59 at the 970 long leg) for the view that 960 flips from support to resistance; breakeven 959.10 pays out even if the wall merely caps a bounce rather than breaking decisively.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss 10.90 pts = net debit (970 put 19.40 ask - 940 put 8.50 bid); max gain 19.10 pts on the 30-pt width; breakeven 959.10.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 980, where call OI is building (+59 today) and the 0.30-delta band sits, puts the 30-pt width fully out of the money with 32 days of theta against it.

strategies.name: Long strangle 940 put / 1010 call
strategies.rationale: Direction-agnostic version of the same short-gamma read: with net GEX negative at all 23 strikes dealers amplify either way, and 1010 is the strike where that flips - the lower-conviction cell, since IV at a 7-session high 15.04 carries real IV-crush risk.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss 12.70 pts = total debit (940 put 8.70 ask + 1010 call 4.00 ask); breakevens 927.30 and 1022.70 against a 1-sigma-to-expiry of 43.9 pts (9.16 x sqrt(23)).
strategies.invalidation: ATM IV falling back to the 13.34 level of 2026-11-20 with spot ranging inside 960-980 bleeds the debit through theta and vega simultaneously.

S50Z26.prediction: Bias stays lower while 966.8 holds below the 1010 gamma boundary: a break of 960 on rising put volume should extend toward the 930-940 shelf where 1,571 puts were built in the last two sessions, since short dealer gamma sells into weakness rather than absorbing it. The 53.2-pt gap to max pain at 1020 is not a mean-reversion target - it has been static for 5 sessions while price walked away from it. A daily close above 1010 invalidates this: it returns spot to call-dominated gamma, after which the 1050-1100 call OI stack becomes the relevant ceiling instead.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position sizing is implied. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, so there is no physical delivery and the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker than for share-settled single stocks: treat max pain at 1020 and the 960 put wall as tendencies, not guarantees. Defined-risk does not mean risk-free - the quoted max losses (8.10, 10.90 and 12.70 pts) are real and fully realisable. The 1100 call wall carries the largest call OI on the board (2,774) but traded only 9 contracts today with price 133 pts away, so it is a stale structural level and should not be weighted as live resistance; macro or news flow can override the entire option structure outright.
